diy.title: DIY Center
diy.description: One configuration for your existing and future hosts. Changes apply when clients refresh subscriptions.
diy.resetHint: Subscription options only. Custom routing is retained.
diy.saveFailed: Could not save. Your subscription and routing drafts are retained.
diy.loadFailed: Could not load DIY settings. Your draft is retained.
diy.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Refresh to load current revisions while keeping your draft, then review and save.
diy.routingPending: Settings saved. Routing deployment is pending.
diy.routingFailed: Settings are saved. Routing needs recovery; review its deployment status.
diy.validationFailed: Review the highlighted options before saving.

hints.tls: Client handshake tuning. Addresses, SNI, keys and credentials remain administrator controlled.
hints.xhttp: Uses only compatible endpoint modes and client options. Server paths and transport identity are retained.
hints.xmux: HTTP connection reuse, separate from Xray Mux.
hints.sockopt: Applies on the client device; platform support varies. Zero and documented sentinel values are retained.
hints.download: Tune a separate download connection while inheriting its administrator-controlled endpoint.
hints.shadowsocks: Client network and packet behavior. UoT requires compatible server support.
hints.mux: Xray Mux and XUDP only. This does not enable sing-box or Mihomo multiplex protocols.
hints.singboxMux: SagerNet multiplex is separate from Xray Mux. Enabling requires compatible server capabilities.
hints.mihomoMux: Mihomo sing-mux requires compatible server capabilities; it is not Xray Mux.

reasons.format: This format has no documented equivalent.
reasons.protocol: The endpoint protocol does not support this option.
reasons.serverCapability: The server does not advertise this protocol capability.
reasons.value: This client cannot represent this value.
reasons.serverMode: The mode conflicts with the endpoint.
reasons.mode: A separate download connection is unavailable in stream-one mode.
reasons.dependency: This option is inactive in the current mode.

restrictions.go121: MPTCP requires a compatible OS and Go 1.21+ client.
restrictions.singboxCurves: sing-box curve preferences require 1.13+ and the Go TLS engine.
restrictions.stashInterface: Stash interface binding is available on macOS.
restrictions.stashUotVersions: Stash UoT requires iOS/tvOS 3.1.1+ or macOS 3.1+, plus a compatible server.
restrictions.stashXhttpVersions: Stash XHTTP requires iOS/tvOS 3.6+ or macOS 4.3+.
restrictions.serverCapability: Enabling requires a compatible server protocol.

errors.invalid: Enter a supported value within the displayed bounds.
errors.conflict: These options conflict. Keep one mode or restore inheritance.
errors.dependency: Configure the required parent option first.
errors.serverCapability: This server protocol is unavailable for your endpoints.
errors.xrayValidation: The resulting client options failed pinned Xray validation. Review dependent options.
errors.whitelistInvalid: Enter unique public IPs within your quota.
errors.splitInvalid: A host or mode is unavailable. Select compatible hosts or remove the profile.

whitelist.title: IP whitelist
whitelist.enabled: Require whitelisted IPs on all nodes
whitelist.hint: Only these IPs may use your credentials. They bypass firewall bans; non-Reality geolocation limits remain.
whitelist.blocksAll: No IPs added. Enabling this blocks all connections with your credentials.

phase.inactive: No eligible node access. Your list is retained.

split.title: Split profiles
split.hint: Use two XHTTP hosts sharing one node and inbound. Ordinary hosts stay available.
split.unavailable: Two accessible hosts sharing the same XHTTP session are required.

diy.noApplicableFields: No applicable options for your current hosts.
diy.quoteChanged: Allowance or price changed. The quote has refreshed and your draft is retained. Review it before saving again.
diy.rangeInvalid: Enter a number or an ascending range, such as 100-200.
